notes: GIF assets are converted to temporary MP4 with ffmpeg before upload.
This media judge is evidence-quality QA; it does not replace backend/browser production gates.

asset.title: Video
asset.purpose: Live Playwright browser benchmark proof clip. Judge only visible product behavior: fresh-room flow, uploads, public NodeAgent invocation, streaming/tool traces, focus/attention UI, artifact creation/download, and production honesty. Clip duration, silence, or README pacing is not a product defect.

judge.summary: The video successfully demonstrates the end-to-end benchmark execution of NodeAgent within a collaborative room, showing file uploads, task initiation, agent execution traces, and final deliverable generation.

featureClarity.evidence: The interface clearly displays the collaborative workspace, uploaded files, and active agent execution.

workflowCompleteness.evidence: Shows the full sequence from room creation and document upload to agent execution and final output preview.

visualDesign.evidence: The dark-themed, high-density layout is functional, though the dense text panels can feel slightly cluttered.

consistency.evidence: Aligns with the core product concept of combining files, spreadsheets, and agent traces in one workspace.

evidenceQuality.evidence: Captures a live, unedited benchmark run with real-time tool execution and file generation.

legibility.evidence: Most UI elements and spreadsheet cells are readable, though some log text is quite small.

professionalRelevance.evidence: Highly relevant to financial analysts and developers evaluating automated banking workflows.

productionHonesty.evidence: Accurately displays execution delays, retries, and live trace logs without artificial cuts.

observedEvidence: NodeAgent task invocation and streaming traces
Artifact generation and previewing of generated PDFs and spreadsheets

defects.observed: A temporary connection failure message appears in the chat during deliverable retrieval before successfully retrying.
defects.fix: Optimize backend polling or handle the transient error state more gracefully in the UI to avoid flashing failure messages.

judge.suggestedReadmeCaption: Watch NodeAgent process financial source documents in a collaborative room to generate a complete valuation model, presentation deck, and support memo.
